MRI Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Umbra Fixation System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
• Static magnetic field of 3-Tesla or less
• Spatial field gradient: ≤ 19 T/m (1,900 G/cm)
• Maximum MR system reported, whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 0.5-W/kg (Normal Operating Mode)
• head averaged SAR of 0.1 W/kg
• Body transmit coil or head transmit coil
• Scan regions: Exclusion zone: do not position the isocenter between the C7 vertebra and the iliac crest
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Umbra Fixation System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 2.1 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
In non-clinical testing, the image artifact caused by the device extends approximately 10 mm from the device when imaged with a gradient echo pulse sequence and a 3-Tesla MR system.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
